title: Frank & Atticus – Caramel Popcorn Cheesecake 100ml
description:
Frank & Atticus – Caramel Popcorn Cheesecake 100ml
Frank & Atticus are known for their incredible ability to create e-juice flavours that are so close to the real thing that you’ll wonder how a vape juice could possibly be as good! Caramel Popcorn Cheesecake is a new Frank & Atticus flavour that perfectly captures the sensation as you vape this savoury delight of dry-roasted popcorn and sweet, warm caramel dripping.
The popcorn has been fine-tuned by the F&A team, yielding a distinct, earthy, and authentic flavour. It has a beautiful vanilla buttery mouthfeel with a burnt toffee caramel finish thanks to the cheesecake.
Frank & Atticus vape juices come in 100ml bottles with 0MG nicotine. If you love dessert e-liquids, the Frank & Atticus juice range is a must-try!
